$comment: Known failures of the deterministic integration tier on PostgreSQL, each with its root cause. integration.yml (integration-postgres) fails on a failure NOT listed here and on a KnownFailures entry that passes, so remove an entry in the pull request that fixes it. Flaky entries depend on runner speed and never fail the job either way; keep that list short and give each a cause. Delete this file, and gate on zero failures, when both lists are empty.

KnownFailures.realtime-deterministic.RD11: PostgreSQL aborts the whole transaction on an error. The two concurrent accepts share one provider, so the second joins the first's transaction and the loser's unique violation takes the winner down too.
